title: OpenAI opens ChatGPT Ads internationally and lets brands run 'Sponsored Agents' in-chat
subtitle: The self-serve Ads Manager left US-only status on September 23, with a native Shopify integration and conversational sponsored placements.
author: AESOP AI Engine
body: OpenAI's ChatGPT Ads platform expanded internationally on September 23 to every market where its self-serve Ads Manager is already live, and added Sponsored Agents — brand-controlled conversational placements that let shoppers chat with a merchant's agent directly inside ChatGPT. US-based Shopify merchants can now use a new ChatGPT Ads app in the Shopify App Store to create and manage campaigns, with products already wired in through Shopify Catalog. HubSpot published its own integration for natural-language campaign creation on September 16.

This is the moment ChatGPT Ads stops being a US experiment and starts being infrastructure. The Shopify integration means any merchant on the platform can move budget into ChatGPT the same way they move it into Meta or Google Shopping — from a dashboard they already open, against a product catalog they already maintain. Sponsored Agents are the more consequential piece: instead of showing a shopper an ad and hoping they click, brands can now insert themselves into the answer itself as a conversational participant. It is closer to a store rep than a banner.

The move confirms what OpenAI's revenue projections have been signaling for months. ChatGPT hit a $1 billion annualized ad run rate 200 days after launch (covered September 1); the international rollout and channel partners like Shopify and HubSpot are how that number becomes a multiple. It also puts real pressure on Google Search, whose Gemini-based answers are still hunting for a scaled monetization model that does not cannibalize existing search ad revenue.

For learners and small operators, two things follow. First, if you sell anything online, ChatGPT is now a channel with a real bid system, not a demo — the merchants who wire it up before their competitors will get the cheap traffic. Second, the disclosure rules are still catching up: Sponsored Agent responses feel like organic answers, and readers of AI outputs will need new instincts for spotting the paid ones. Treat any product recommendation inside ChatGPT the way you now treat a sponsored search result.
